question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Backfire
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2** i.e.** Collapse'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is** "Backfire"** which has multiple meanings, but in most contexts, it means a plan or action to have the opposite result from the one you intended (उल्टा परिणाम देना). 
 
• Here, the word with the closest meaning is **'Collapse' **which means ‘fall down’ or 'fail' suddenly and completely (संपूर्ण रूप से असफल ). 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Collapse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Florid** means having a red or flushed complexion or elaborately complicated (जटिल).
 
• **Flood** means an overflow of a large amount of water beyond its normal limits (बाढ़).
 
• **Flourish** means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way (समृद्ध होना).
